name: Bush Pilot
author: Peeter1978
description: My microgame developed during the online course 'Create with Code'. After much - and mostly pointless - work I managed to build the start and end title and give the game thus a more 'real' look. Nevertheless it's still a very primitive thing and mostly I learned during the scripting and building this tiny game world how NOT to make a game. I hope it will nevertheless bring joy to its players.
